intro: If you or someone near you feels unsafe or is thinking about ending their life, please reach out to a person right now. You do not have to handle this alone.
emergency: If there is immediate danger, contact your local emergency services or go to the nearest hospital emergency department.
emptyNote: Local helpline numbers for your area are added here by your psychologist or institute. Until then, please ask your psychologist, a trusted adult or a family member for help right away.
